name: Navigation Back Action Vector Icon
description: Standard left-pointing directional arrow icon used in top app bar for screen dismissal and backward stack navigation.
behavior_summary: Scalable SVG vector icon asset conforming to Material 24dp bounding box with crisp rendering across high-DPI displays.

reusability_assessment.notes: Vector asset authorized for project use; directly importable into Family OS design system icon suite.

name: Material Alert Dialog Layout Framework
description: Composite modal dialog component supporting title, message body, custom view injection, and positive/negative/neutral actions.
behavior_summary: Structural three-tier dialog hierarchy arranging title, content/custom scrollable view, and button action bar.

reusability_assessment.notes: Authorized for adoption; layout structure serves as technical blueprint for Flutter FosAlertDialog widget implementation.

name: Local Messages SQLite Master Store
description: High-throughput local persistence store for message history, media metadata, read/unread states, and transmission queues.
behavior_summary: Operates under Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode to permit concurrent read queries during intensive background message batch ingestion.

reusability_assessment.notes: Authorized for adoption; schema architecture adapts to Drift (SQLite) tables for Family OS local messaging storage (S1-08).

name: Multi-DC Connections Manager & Protocol Cascade
description: Resilient client network engine managing connections to distributed data centers with automated transport fallback.
behavior_summary: Attempts direct TCP sockets; provides architectural fallback pattern for HTTP proxying and Secure WebSockets upon firewall blockage.

reusability_assessment.notes: Authorized for adoption; informs architectural pattern for Family OS realtime gateway connectivity without raw binary reuse.

name: Cloud PTS Sequence & Gap Resolution Engine
description: State synchronization algorithm ensuring message ordering, deduplication, and gap recovery across offline intervals.
behavior_summary: Maintains persistent PTS monotonic sequence numbers; upon sequence discontinuity, buffers out-of-order messages and requests difference payload.

reusability_assessment.notes: Authorized for adoption; algorithmic mathematical model to be implemented natively in Dart for Family OS offline-first synchronization.

name: Declared Notifications Foreground Service
description: Declaration of NotificationsService in AndroidManifest.xml configured as an enabled and exported foreground service with dataSync type.
behavior_summary: Manifest-declared foreground service configuration binding dataSync foreground type, establishing system-level registration for background data synchronization.

reusability_assessment.notes: Authorized for adoption; provides reference configuration for registering Android background data synchronization services in Family OS without unjustified runtime assumptions.
